login.title: Sign in with email or phone
login.description: Enter your email address or phone number to receive a one-time passcode. No account creation required.
login.errorInvalidPhone: Invalid phone number. Please use international format (e.g., +1 234 567 8901 for US)
login.errorInvalidPhoneFormat: Phone numbers must be in E.164 format (e.g., +12345678901 for US numbers)
login.errorInvalidIdentifier: Please enter a valid email address or phone number in international format
login.mockModeDescription: This code is displayed because MOCK_SMS or MOCK_EMAIL is enabled.
login.disclaimer: Do not enter your real information

preferences.title: Your Preferences
preferences.description: Control how your personal information is handled in the contact management system. For each field, choose whether it should be kept private, stored but not shared with third-party apps, or stored and shared.
preferences.explanation: When someone creates a contact card with your information, your choice below determines whether the field is stored on the contact provider and whether it can be accessed by third-party apps through OAuth.

states.storedNoApi: Store, but don't share with third-party apps
states.storedApi: Store and share with third-party apps

birthday.label: Birthday
birthday.description: Date of birth and age information

preferences.statusUnsaved: You have unsaved changes. Save them to apply to the contact provider.
preferences.statusSynced: Your privacy preferences are synchronized with the contact provider.
preferences.loadErrorDescription: Unable to load your current privacy settings. Please refresh the page.
preferences.networkError: Network error. Please check your connection and refresh the page.
preferences.saveSuccessDescription: Your privacy settings have been synchronized with the contact provider.
preferences.saveErrorDescription: Please try again. If the problem persists, contact support.
preferences.saveNetworkError: Network error. Please check your connection and try again.

access.title: Data about you
access.description: See how your personal information is used in the contact provider system and how other users are storing your data. This transparency helps you make informed decisions about your Subject Data Preferences.
access.metaDescription: See how your personal information is used in the contact provider system and how other users are storing your data. Here is all data associated with {{contact}}.
access.providerDescription: Synchronize with the contact provider to refresh the data shown on this page and ensure you see the most current information about how your data is being used.

a.none: No contact record containing your information was found.
a.found: Contact records containing your information were found.

download.title: Download your data
download.description: You have the right to receive a copy of the personal data stored about you in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format. This page lets you export the contact data currently displayed for your account as a JSON (.json) file, matching the disclosure level you selected.
download.sectionDescription: The export contains exactly the data shown on the data access page for your current disclosure level. Fields you marked as private in your Data Preferences are not included, as they have already been removed from the stored cards.
download.errorDescription: Unable to download your data. Please try again. If the problem persists, contact support.

errors.notFoundMessage: The requested page could not be found.
